svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 07/12 The Old Barns (Common)
svg.desc: Weathered ranch buildings by the entrance, from when this whole hill was a ranch. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
